const Engine = opaque {};

const Len = usize;
const Bytes = [*]const u8;
const Ctx = *Engine;
const MaybeCtx = ?*Engine;
const NotAType = 42;

const AliasedLen = Len;
const AliasedEngine = Engine;

export fn zc_alias(n: Len, b: Bytes, c: Ctx, m: MaybeCtx, out: *Len) void {
    _ = n;
    _ = b;
    _ = c;
    _ = m;
    _ = out;
}

export fn zc_chain(n: AliasedLen, e: *AliasedEngine) void {
    _ = n;
    _ = e;
}

export fn zc_bad_alias(x: NotAType) void {
    _ = x;
}
